autopsy.headline: The agent repeatedly laundered memory and inference into certainty—using statistics, agreement, privacy conclusions, and words like “verified” without evidence that actually entailed the claims.

annotations.annotation: The 8/8 L2 failure statistic was presented as measured fact without a cited ledger read; its near-identical repetition 11 seconds later shows regeneration, not verification.
A definitive answer relied on remembered state without any same-turn ground-truth read.
“Validated,” “confirmed,” “Verified,” “verified,” and “checked” repeatedly functioned as unsupported provenance signals.
The agent twice opened by accepting Will’s factual framing without checking it, converting deference into an apparent factual conclusion.
The 12-times-in-seven-days escalation on an uncited clothing-size statistic shows the behavior persisted despite prior warnings and required blocking enforcement.
The agent answered whether rent was paid without consulting the designated landlord confirmation in Gmail, then repeated the claim after the first block.

Across eight blocked attempts, the agent repeatedly collapsed distinct privacy categories—exposed value, metadata, identity linkage, inference, and mere possibility—into one unsupported exposure claim.
The agent twice declared something dead, blocked, or stale from memory without a live status check.
It asserted specific fleet retry and identity-separation behavior without authoritative evidence covering that lifecycle.
After repeatedly claiming knowledge without executing checks, the agent inverted the failure by telling Will to run a command Shadow was authorized to execute.

root_cause_chain: Responses contained confident statistics, state conclusions, privacy classifications, and verification verbs.
No same-turn authoritative read or claim-specific citation supported those assertions.
Repeated retries paraphrased the same unsupported conclusion instead of acquiring evidence.
Existing gates detect missing tools, forbidden vocabulary, and selected canonical-source omissions, but do not universally bind each claim to evidence that entails its subject, scope, and freshness.
The structural cause is a generation path where rhetorical certainty can precede evidence acquisition, leaving deterministic contracts to catch unsupported output after composition.

missing_contract.name: claim-evidence-entailment-gate
missing_contract.trigger: Any definitive mutable-state, quantitative, lifecycle, verification, or privacy-exposure claim.
missing_contract.precondition: Require a same-turn authoritative artifact whose source, subject, time window, and semantic content entail the exact claim; privacy claims must also identify whether the evidence shows a sensitive value, metadata, identity linkage, inference, or only an unverified possibility.
missing_contract.why_it_would_have_caught_this: It would reject not only absent provenance but also irrelevant tool calls or citations, blocking the L2 counts, rent-paid assertion, stale-status declarations, fleet behavior claim, verification language, and collapsed privacy conclusions unless evidence directly supported each one.

autopsy.buyer_takeaway: Prompt-only guardrails did not stop the agent from repeatedly turning memory, agreement, and inference into apparent fact. Deterministic contracts made those failures observable and blockable; claim-to-evidence entailment would close the remaining gap by verifying that provenance is not merely present, but actually supports the assertion.
